1	# Architecture and development
2	
3	The public entrypoint is `python -m open_instruct.miles`. Its structured RunSpec
4	compiles into a RunConfig containing CoreConfig and native MILES options.
5	The Python API is available for integrations; use the structured workflow when
6	preparation, placement and submission should come from one file.
7	
8	| Layer | Owns |
9	|---|---|
10	| Open Instruct wrapper | Config validation, preparation, verifiers, launch/receipts, run artifacts |
11	| MILES runtime | Rollout actors, SGLang engines, sample/advantage/loss machinery, shared transport helpers |
12	| Core adapter (in MILES) | Model construction, document/replay alignment, scoring/training forward, gradient synchronization, optimizer/checkpoints and tensor export |
13	| OLMo-core | Model and distributed-training primitives, attention/expert execution |
14	| olmo-sglang | Serving architecture registration and model-specific execution |
15	
16	The Core actor at `miles.backends.core_utils.actor.OLMoCoreTrainRayActor` implements
17	the MILES trainer boundary. Its model/checkpoint code and publication machinery
18	live in the pinned MILES fork. The driver coordinates collections, optimization and versioned weight
19	publication. Dense standard-model support is isolated from the specialized MoE
20	path. [Implementation contracts](core.md) describe the detailed lifecycle and
21	[packing](sequence-packing.md) describes document/routing alignment.
22	
23	## Runtime sources and images
24	
25	[`runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json`](../../runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json) is the
26	source of truth for exact dependency commits and the immutable binary base.
27	Builds fetch those commits without patches or moving branch tips. MILES uses the
28	organized adapter hooks; OLMo-core provides the model, objective and checkpoint
29	APIs required by this adapter; olmo-sglang supplies compatible serving models.
30	The ordinary Open Instruct environment keeps its own dependency versions.
31	
32	The MILES pin includes the v0.1.2 async-consumer compatibility fix from
33	[miles-olmo-core PR #10](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/pull/10).
34	Its refresh and engine-drain dequeues accept the native consumer's optional trainer
35	identity and preserve Core's explicit rejection of multi-policy training.
36	
37	The binary base contains the compiled dependencies, including FA2, FA3 and FA4.
38	It excludes the MILES, Core, SGLang and Open Instruct source overlays. Application
39	builds add locked source repositories as `runtime-base`, then the committed Open
40	Instruct checkout as `application`. They do not compile FlashAttention, even
41	without a local Docker cache. Source-only lock changes rebuild source layers;
42	binary dependency changes require a new base. Editable installs still fetch
43	build-system dependencies such as setuptools and pybind11, and Megatron builds
44	a small C++ dataset helper. Those build-tool requirements are not fully pinned;
45	the source and base pins do not make application builds bit-for-bit reproducible.
46	
47	The selected base is Beaker `01M5ZYQZVF7DDJ1VR619KRSS42`
48	(`robertb/miles-binary-base-20261027`), Docker
49	`sha256:947e615f93cb88f8739ba270f30adc7f012af8bc0abf43e96f11cd5d3b2d6354`.
50	Its package versions, CPU imports and source isolation were checked, and a pull
51	by immutable ID reproduced the same Docker ID. The
52	[single-GPU Core RL smoke](https://beaker.org/ex/01M61Z3VBAD5219PHZX63YGDY7)
53	passed on application image `01M61Z2XBQB6EP3SJNAX1YN0HV`: four optimizer updates,
54	shared-engine evaluations, checkpoints and HF export on Holmes. This tiny-model
55	check uses Torch attention; it does not qualify every FlashAttention backend or
56	a Qwen OPD GPU training run with the public Megatron sources.
57	The application image (`robertb/miles-main-smoke-5a7be0398`) was built from
58	`5a7be0398e8244cd5376983427e57d4deeea2e39`, Docker
59	`sha256:83cc907a035f98ba69d3b8b7eaaaaa7477d1c06c6efca39da4414ef174df3c67`,
60	and includes the current public source lock and review cleanup.
61	
62	A CPU-only `runtime-base` rebuild from commit
63	`3563eb52ac4b02d731786e8f1a4e39a52951f2a2` is published as Beaker image
64	`01M61YFEWE1BATA8KQ4VAV2DY8` (`robertb/miles-runtime-base-3563eb52a`), Docker
65	`sha256:f97469549508d2af9896161889cc45060c52ece5743ecfcbe937039d3043b784`.
66	Its packaged lock matches the current lock, all six source checkouts match their
67	pinned revisions without patches, and serving/attention CPU imports passed.
68	This records CPU build verification of the runtime sources separately from the
69	application-image GPU smoke above, which subsequently verified the same source lock.
70	
71	The source layer includes Megatron-LM from the Radix fork, pinned to
72	`235952df607b3820716e5e67728a5ab470ca33ae` (the previous runtime's revision,
73	including its Qwen3.5 FP32 optimizer fix), rather than the current `miles-main`
74	tip used by the pinned MILES Dockerfile. Megatron Bridge uses the public Radix
75	revision selected by that Dockerfile. These dependencies support Qwen OPD.
76	The image does not install `olmo-megatron`, the private Olmo Bridge fork, or
77	Olmo-specific Megatron patches; Olmo training uses the Core backend. Package
78	metadata and entrypoints are installed with `--no-deps` to preserve the binary
79	stack. `/src/Megatron-LM` remains a compatibility symlink for the OPD launcher.
80	
81	EOPD metadata transport is implemented in the pinned MILES source, without a
82	local runtime patch. Open Instruct's `opd_hooks` stores teacher top-k values in
83	`Sample.train_metadata`;
84	[rollout conversion](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/blob/296a1e80c9c726bc41a764ce7cfcab2c886da64a/miles/ray/rollout/train_data_conversion.py#L173-L174)
85	copies those dictionaries into `train_data["metadata"]`, and the
86	[Megatron training step](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/blob/296a1e80c9c726bc41a764ce7cfcab2c886da64a/miles/backends/megatron_utils/model.py#L465-L496)
87	requests `metadata` from `get_batch` for the custom loss. This training field is
88	separate from the input dataset metadata selected by `--metadata-key`.
89	
90	For ordinary application builds:
91	
92	```bash
93	python scripts/miles/build_image.py --base-image LOCAL_LOADED_BASE_IMAGE --tag open-instruct:miles-core
94	```
95	
96	Use `--target runtime-base` to build only the locked dependency sources, without
97	adding the Open Instruct application checkout. The default target is `application`.
98	The image arguments are local Docker tags loaded on the build host; Beaker names
99	and immutable IDs identify the images to pull before invoking the helper.
100	
101	All repositories in the runtime lock are public; no GitHub credential is needed
102	for these source fetches. Standalone source preparation can use
103	`--cache olmo-sglang=/path/to/clone`.
104	Existing published images retain their original sources; rebuild after changing
105	the lock.
106	
107	prepare_runtime refuses to replace existing source directories. Its --cache
108	arguments can use local clones as fetch sources; they do not select uncommitted
109	sibling code. build_image checks the immutable base Docker ID. For actual
110	submission use the [committed-image launcher](launching.md), not a one-off Beaker
111	command with different mounts or source provenance.
112	
113	## Rebuilding the binary base
114	
115	The reproducible maintainer recipe is `runtime/miles/Dockerfile.base`; its two
116	immutable inputs are recorded in `runtime/miles/base-build.lock.json`. Pull both
117	Beaker images into Docker, then run:
118	
119	```bash
120	python scripts/miles/build_base_image.py \
121	  --compiled-parent LOCAL_COMPILED_PARENT \
122	  --flash-attention-builder LOCAL_FA3_BUILDER \
123	  --tag open-instruct:miles-binary-base
124	```
125	
126	Both Docker IDs are verified, and the parent-image label comes from the same
127	lock. The helper passes the compiler image as `FLASH_ATTENTION_BUILDER` and the
128	runtime parent as `COMPILED_PARENT`. Only FA wheels are transferred from the compiler
129	image to the clean compiled parent. FA2/FA4 wheel downloads are checksum-verified;
130	the final stage resets inherited application metadata and entrypoints. This
131	preserves the qualified CUDA/PyTorch stack rather than rebuilding all dependencies
132	from an upstream CUDA distribution. Build on an amd64 Linux host: FA3 compilation
133	defaults to two jobs, with `--max-jobs` available for hosts with sufficient RAM.
134	The published base's FA3 build took about 31 minutes with eight jobs.
135	
136	The final environment list was compared with the locked compiled parent. It
137	preserves its runtime settings while dropping legacy `OLMO_MILES_*` cache and
138	verifier paths. Recheck this list against the parent image whenever changing the
139	parent pin; `FROM scratch` does not inherit environment variables automatically.
140	
141	Before changing the pin again, verify CPU imports, an application build and GPU
142	forward/backward and training on the intended hardware. CPU imports alone do not
143	establish GPU correctness.
144	
145	## Startup dependencies
146	
147	Managed GRPO starts judge loading, Ray startup, and workflow model/data preparation
148	concurrently after assigning GPUs and discovering judge endpoint addresses. Ray
149	readiness and judge known-answer canaries run in separate supervised subprocesses.
150	The driver waits for the exact Ray layout before placement; it waits for judge
151	qualification before generation or evaluation. Readiness files live in the fresh
152	attempt directory, with peer-failure propagation. After replica rendezvous, rank
153	zero writes one `startup.json` deadline shared by all supervisors, readiness
154	probes, and driver barriers. Inventory and service launch consume that same
155	budget; starting a later stage does not reset it. Post-training completion has
156	its own timeout.
157	
158	On disaggregated runs with an explicit rollout count and resident inference,
159	trainer initialization/cache restoration overlaps inference initialization.
160	Connecting trainer parallelism metadata and restoring the rollout cursor remains
161	a barrier after both branches finish, before initial weight publication. Colocated,
162	offloaded-inference, and epoch-derived schedules retain sequential initialization.
163	OPD uses its separate launcher and does not pass through this GRPO supervisor.
164	
165	A failed or cancelled initialization joins its sibling tasks before driver cleanup;
166	the worker manager owns partially initialized remote workers. Cluster supervision
167	also terminates outstanding readiness subprocesses. Judge liveness monitoring
168	starts only after its HTTP endpoint becomes ready.
169	
170	For measurement, the attempt directory contains process start receipts, readiness
171	timestamps. Each probe writes its own timeline under `ray-readiness/driver_timing.jsonl`
172	or `judge-readiness/driver_timing.jsonl`, avoiding concurrent appends on WEKA. The run
173	root has preparation-stage timings; the checkpoint directory has runtime parsing,
174	module import, readiness waits, serving/trainer initialization, connection and
175	publication timings. Overlapping stage durations must not be added together as
176	elapsed startup time. Small-model integration validates ordering and cleanup;
177	full-model wall-time savings require measurement on the intended hardware.
178	
179	## Local development
180	
181	The ordinary CPU suite covers configuration, planning, launch specifications,
182	rewards, data preparation, rendezvous, heartbeat, recovery and topology contracts
183	without installing MILES or
184	SGLang. The `MILES contracts` workflow also checks the maintained scripts and
185	checks application types without requiring the private runtime.
186	Recording and summary implementation tests live with their MILES implementation;
187	Open Instruct keeps record configuration tests and runtime selection/buffer integration tests.
188	The moved adapter is checked against that Core API in the dedicated runtime
189	environment; Open Instruct's ordinary type check covers the application integration.
190	The MoE numerical tests deliberately require the Core revision in the runtime
191	lock. The ordinary `uv.lock` Core version is for existing SFT/DPO paths and is
192	not upgraded to make those runtime-only tests importable.
193	
194	```bash
195	uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles*.py
196	```
197	
198	The dedicated runtime suite uses the separate application image. From its
199	`/opt/core-rl` working directory, run:
200	
201	```bash
202	bash scripts/miles/test_runtime.sh -q
203	```
204	
205	This command fails if runtime dependencies are missing. Without the explicit
206	runtime flag, ordinary CPU collection omits `tests/miles/` when MILES or SGLang
207	is absent. CUDA numerical cases skip when no GPU is visible. A passing CPU run
208	therefore does not check GPU kernels, distributed gradients or publication.
209	The ordinary Open Instruct GPU CI image does not include the private MILES
210	runtime; dedicated runtime checks are a separate maintainer validation step.
211	
212	For a training lifecycle check, copy [dev.toml](../../configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml)
213	to `runs/`, select a compatible tiny checkpoint, and follow the
214	[committed-image launcher](launching.md). Verify the rendered replica group and
215	retain image, config and completion artifacts. Test refresh separately when
216	changing publication behavior; a tiny mechanics check does not establish learning
217	quality.
218	
219	## Documentation checks
220	
221	```bash
222	python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs --check
223	uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles_documentation.py
224	uv run mkdocs build
225	make style-check
226	make quality-check
227	```
228	
229	MkDocs generates the four reference pages in memory from configuration sources,
230	the compact pinned parser schema and reviewed `reference-help.json` descriptions.
231	Neither the pages nor native help are tracked. Ordinary documentation builds and
232	local `plan`/`validate` commands need no MILES installation. Without a native help
233	capture, option tables show names, types, choices, restrictions and reviewed
234	supplements; other help and value defaults are explicitly marked unavailable.
235	
236	When runtime pins change, regenerate the compact schema inside the matching
237	runtime and review its diff:
238	
239	```bash
240	python -m scripts.miles.snapshot_options open_instruct/miles/configuration/options.json
241	```
242	
243	For full upstream help and parser defaults, capture an artifact in the pinned
244	runtime using a writable checkout, then supply it to the documentation build:
245	
246	```bash

# Architecture and development

The public entrypoint is `python -m open_instruct.miles`. Its structured RunSpec
compiles into a RunConfig containing CoreConfig and native MILES options.
The Python API is available for integrations; use the structured workflow when
preparation, placement and submission should come from one file.

| Layer | Owns |
|---|---|
| Open Instruct wrapper | Config validation, preparation, verifiers, launch/receipts, run artifacts |
| MILES runtime | Rollout actors, SGLang engines, sample/advantage/loss machinery, shared transport helpers |
| Core adapter (in MILES) | Model construction, document/replay alignment, scoring/training forward, gradient synchronization, optimizer/checkpoints and tensor export |
| OLMo-core | Model and distributed-training primitives, attention/expert execution |
| olmo-sglang | Serving architecture registration and model-specific execution |

The Core actor at `miles.backends.core_utils.actor.OLMoCoreTrainRayActor` implements
the MILES trainer boundary. Its model/checkpoint code and publication machinery
live in the pinned MILES fork. The driver coordinates collections, optimization and versioned weight
publication. Dense standard-model support is isolated from the specialized MoE
path. [Implementation contracts](core.md) describe the detailed lifecycle and
[packing](sequence-packing.md) describes document/routing alignment.

## Runtime sources and images

[`runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json`](../../runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json) is the
source of truth for exact dependency commits and the immutable binary base.
Builds fetch those commits without patches or moving branch tips. MILES uses the
organized adapter hooks; OLMo-core provides the model, objective and checkpoint
APIs required by this adapter; olmo-sglang supplies compatible serving models.
The ordinary Open Instruct environment keeps its own dependency versions.

The MILES pin includes the v0.1.2 async-consumer compatibility fix from
[miles-olmo-core PR #10](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/pull/10).
Its refresh and engine-drain dequeues accept the native consumer's optional trainer
identity and preserve Core's explicit rejection of multi-policy training.

The binary base contains the compiled dependencies, including FA2, FA3 and FA4.
It excludes the MILES, Core, SGLang and Open Instruct source overlays. Application
builds add locked source repositories as `runtime-base`, then the committed Open
Instruct checkout as `application`. They do not compile FlashAttention, even
without a local Docker cache. Source-only lock changes rebuild source layers;
binary dependency changes require a new base. Editable installs still fetch
build-system dependencies such as setuptools and pybind11, and Megatron builds
a small C++ dataset helper. Those build-tool requirements are not fully pinned;
the source and base pins do not make application builds bit-for-bit reproducible.

The selected base is Beaker `01M5ZYQZVF7DDJ1VR619KRSS42`
(`robertb/miles-binary-base-20261027`), Docker
`sha256:947e615f93cb88f8739ba270f30adc7f012af8bc0abf43e96f11cd5d3b2d6354`.
Its package versions, CPU imports and source isolation were checked, and a pull
by immutable ID reproduced the same Docker ID. The
[single-GPU Core RL smoke](https://beaker.org/ex/01M61Z3VBAD5219PHZX63YGDY7)
passed on application image `01M61Z2XBQB6EP3SJNAX1YN0HV`: four optimizer updates,
shared-engine evaluations, checkpoints and HF export on Holmes. This tiny-model
check uses Torch attention; it does not qualify every FlashAttention backend or
a Qwen OPD GPU training run with the public Megatron sources.
The application image (`robertb/miles-main-smoke-5a7be0398`) was built from
`5a7be0398e8244cd5376983427e57d4deeea2e39`, Docker
`sha256:83cc907a035f98ba69d3b8b7eaaaaa7477d1c06c6efca39da4414ef174df3c67`,
and includes the current public source lock and review cleanup.

A CPU-only `runtime-base` rebuild from commit
`3563eb52ac4b02d731786e8f1a4e39a52951f2a2` is published as Beaker image
`01M61YFEWE1BATA8KQ4VAV2DY8` (`robertb/miles-runtime-base-3563eb52a`), Docker
`sha256:f97469549508d2af9896161889cc45060c52ece5743ecfcbe937039d3043b784`.
Its packaged lock matches the current lock, all six source checkouts match their
pinned revisions without patches, and serving/attention CPU imports passed.
This records CPU build verification of the runtime sources separately from the
application-image GPU smoke above, which subsequently verified the same source lock.

The source layer includes Megatron-LM from the Radix fork, pinned to
`235952df607b3820716e5e67728a5ab470ca33ae` (the previous runtime's revision,
including its Qwen3.5 FP32 optimizer fix), rather than the current `miles-main`
tip used by the pinned MILES Dockerfile. Megatron Bridge uses the public Radix
revision selected by that Dockerfile. These dependencies support Qwen OPD.
The image does not install `olmo-megatron`, the private Olmo Bridge fork, or
Olmo-specific Megatron patches; Olmo training uses the Core backend. Package
metadata and entrypoints are installed with `--no-deps` to preserve the binary
stack. `/src/Megatron-LM` remains a compatibility symlink for the OPD launcher.

EOPD metadata transport is implemented in the pinned MILES source, without a
local runtime patch. Open Instruct's `opd_hooks` stores teacher top-k values in
`Sample.train_metadata`;
[rollout conversion](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/blob/296a1e80c9c726bc41a764ce7cfcab2c886da64a/miles/ray/rollout/train_data_conversion.py#L173-L174)
copies those dictionaries into `train_data["metadata"]`, and the
[Megatron training step](https://github.com/allenai/miles-olmo-core/blob/296a1e80c9c726bc41a764ce7cfcab2c886da64a/miles/backends/megatron_utils/model.py#L465-L496)
requests `metadata` from `get_batch` for the custom loss. This training field is
separate from the input dataset metadata selected by `--metadata-key`.

For ordinary application builds:

```bash
python scripts/miles/build_image.py --base-image LOCAL_LOADED_BASE_IMAGE --tag open-instruct:miles-core
```

Use `--target runtime-base` to build only the locked dependency sources, without
adding the Open Instruct application checkout. The default target is `application`.
The image arguments are local Docker tags loaded on the build host; Beaker names
and immutable IDs identify the images to pull before invoking the helper.

All repositories in the runtime lock are public; no GitHub credential is needed
for these source fetches. Standalone source preparation can use
`--cache olmo-sglang=/path/to/clone`.
Existing published images retain their original sources; rebuild after changing
the lock.

prepare_runtime refuses to replace existing source directories. Its --cache
arguments can use local clones as fetch sources; they do not select uncommitted
sibling code. build_image checks the immutable base Docker ID. For actual
submission use the [committed-image launcher](launching.md), not a one-off Beaker
command with different mounts or source provenance.

## Rebuilding the binary base

The reproducible maintainer recipe is `runtime/miles/Dockerfile.base`; its two
immutable inputs are recorded in `runtime/miles/base-build.lock.json`. Pull both
Beaker images into Docker, then run:

```bash
python scripts/miles/build_base_image.py \
  --compiled-parent LOCAL_COMPILED_PARENT \
  --flash-attention-builder LOCAL_FA3_BUILDER \
  --tag open-instruct:miles-binary-base
```

Both Docker IDs are verified, and the parent-image label comes from the same
lock. The helper passes the compiler image as `FLASH_ATTENTION_BUILDER` and the
runtime parent as `COMPILED_PARENT`. Only FA wheels are transferred from the compiler
image to the clean compiled parent. FA2/FA4 wheel downloads are checksum-verified;
the final stage resets inherited application metadata and entrypoints. This
preserves the qualified CUDA/PyTorch stack rather than rebuilding all dependencies
from an upstream CUDA distribution. Build on an amd64 Linux host: FA3 compilation
defaults to two jobs, with `--max-jobs` available for hosts with sufficient RAM.
The published base's FA3 build took about 31 minutes with eight jobs.

The final environment list was compared with the locked compiled parent. It
preserves its runtime settings while dropping legacy `OLMO_MILES_*` cache and
verifier paths. Recheck this list against the parent image whenever changing the
parent pin; `FROM scratch` does not inherit environment variables automatically.

Before changing the pin again, verify CPU imports, an application build and GPU
forward/backward and training on the intended hardware. CPU imports alone do not
establish GPU correctness.

## Startup dependencies

Managed GRPO starts judge loading, Ray startup, and workflow model/data preparation
concurrently after assigning GPUs and discovering judge endpoint addresses. Ray
readiness and judge known-answer canaries run in separate supervised subprocesses.
The driver waits for the exact Ray layout before placement; it waits for judge
qualification before generation or evaluation. Readiness files live in the fresh
attempt directory, with peer-failure propagation. After replica rendezvous, rank
zero writes one `startup.json` deadline shared by all supervisors, readiness
probes, and driver barriers. Inventory and service launch consume that same
budget; starting a later stage does not reset it. Post-training completion has
its own timeout.

On disaggregated runs with an explicit rollout count and resident inference,
trainer initialization/cache restoration overlaps inference initialization.
Connecting trainer parallelism metadata and restoring the rollout cursor remains
a barrier after both branches finish, before initial weight publication. Colocated,
offloaded-inference, and epoch-derived schedules retain sequential initialization.
OPD uses its separate launcher and does not pass through this GRPO supervisor.

A failed or cancelled initialization joins its sibling tasks before driver cleanup;
the worker manager owns partially initialized remote workers. Cluster supervision
also terminates outstanding readiness subprocesses. Judge liveness monitoring
starts only after its HTTP endpoint becomes ready.

For measurement, the attempt directory contains process start receipts, readiness
timestamps. Each probe writes its own timeline under `ray-readiness/driver_timing.jsonl`
or `judge-readiness/driver_timing.jsonl`, avoiding concurrent appends on WEKA. The run
root has preparation-stage timings; the checkpoint directory has runtime parsing,
module import, readiness waits, serving/trainer initialization, connection and
publication timings. Overlapping stage durations must not be added together as
elapsed startup time. Small-model integration validates ordering and cleanup;
full-model wall-time savings require measurement on the intended hardware.

## Local development

The ordinary CPU suite covers configuration, planning, launch specifications,
rewards, data preparation, rendezvous, heartbeat, recovery and topology contracts
without installing MILES or
SGLang. The `MILES contracts` workflow also checks the maintained scripts and
checks application types without requiring the private runtime.
Recording and summary implementation tests live with their MILES implementation;
Open Instruct keeps record configuration tests and runtime selection/buffer integration tests.
The moved adapter is checked against that Core API in the dedicated runtime
environment; Open Instruct's ordinary type check covers the application integration.
The MoE numerical tests deliberately require the Core revision in the runtime
lock. The ordinary `uv.lock` Core version is for existing SFT/DPO paths and is
not upgraded to make those runtime-only tests importable.

```bash
uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles*.py
```

The dedicated runtime suite uses the separate application image. From its
`/opt/core-rl` working directory, run:

```bash
bash scripts/miles/test_runtime.sh -q
```

This command fails if runtime dependencies are missing. Without the explicit
runtime flag, ordinary CPU collection omits `tests/miles/` when MILES or SGLang
is absent. CUDA numerical cases skip when no GPU is visible. A passing CPU run
therefore does not check GPU kernels, distributed gradients or publication.
The ordinary Open Instruct GPU CI image does not include the private MILES
runtime; dedicated runtime checks are a separate maintainer validation step.

For a training lifecycle check, copy [dev.toml](../../configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml)
to `runs/`, select a compatible tiny checkpoint, and follow the
[committed-image launcher](launching.md). Verify the rendered replica group and
retain image, config and completion artifacts. Test refresh separately when
changing publication behavior; a tiny mechanics check does not establish learning
quality.

## Documentation checks

```bash
python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs --check
uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles_documentation.py
uv run mkdocs build
make style-check
make quality-check
```

MkDocs generates the four reference pages in memory from configuration sources,
the compact pinned parser schema and reviewed `reference-help.json` descriptions.
Neither the pages nor native help are tracked. Ordinary documentation builds and
local `plan`/`validate` commands need no MILES installation. Without a native help
capture, option tables show names, types, choices, restrictions and reviewed
supplements; other help and value defaults are explicitly marked unavailable.

When runtime pins change, regenerate the compact schema inside the matching
runtime and review its diff:

```bash
python -m scripts.miles.snapshot_options open_instruct/miles/configuration/options.json
```

For full upstream help and parser defaults, capture an artifact in the pinned
runtime using a writable checkout, then supply it to the documentation build:

```bash
python -m scripts.miles.capture_option_help --image IMMUTABLE_IMAGE_ID --output runs/native-help.json
MILES_NATIVE_HELP=runs/native-help.json uv run mkdocs build
```

The capture checks the installed parser against the expanded compact schema;
the docs build rejects stale hashes or missing actions. Parser defaults are not
model-dependent resolved defaults. To inspect Markdown separately, run
`python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs --output-dir runs/miles-docs` (optionally
with `--native-help runs/native-help.json`). `--check` validates the reference
inputs without writing files. Edit source definitions and reviewed descriptions,
not generated output. Change maintained examples only as a deliberate recipe
change; see [development defaults](development-defaults.md).

### Type checking the moved adapter

In a development environment with the pinned MILES and Core sources, run:

```bash
ty check /path/to/miles/miles/backends/core_utils --extra-search-path /path/to/OLMo-core/src
```

Open Instruct's CPU checks do not fetch the private MILES repository. The committed
application image and runtime tests check both repositories together.

## Adapter package layout

`open_instruct/miles/` groups code by responsibility. The public CLI remains
`python -m open_instruct.miles`; package initializers do not load the GPU runtime.

| Package | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `configuration` | RunSpec/CoreConfig, native options, validation, topology and capacity planning |
| `execution` | Preparation, Beaker submission, cluster bootstrap and training coordination |
| MILES `backends/core_utils` | Core actor, model backends, packing, optimizer scheduling, checkpoints and trainer diagnostics |
| `rollout` | Application data-source selection and rollout metrics; managed generation, admission and completed queues live in MILES `backends/core_utils/rollout` |
| MILES `backends/core_utils/publication` | Weight delivery, engine drain, policy versions and durable policy state |
| `rewards` | Verifiers, reward routing and managed judges |
| `datasets` | Dataset preparation, mixtures, inference records and prompt selection |
| `evaluation` | Background evaluation submission, workers and result publication |
| `infrastructure` | Application artifact publication and bounded infrastructure waits; compiler/HF cache lifecycle lives in MILES |

Keep diagnostics next to the component they observe. Keep configuration imports
CPU-only, model backends loaded on demand, and package initializers minimal.
MILES `backends/core_utils/data.py` adapts samples to the trainer; `rollout/data_source.py` owns
runtime data-source behavior; `datasets/run_data.py` prepares researcher inputs.

Python integration imports use these package paths, for example
`from open_instruct.miles.configuration.run_spec import RunSpec`. The pinned
AllenAI MILES fork must use the matching trainer and rollout hook paths. Rebuild
the application image when updating this layout and its runtime pin together;
existing images retain their original code. Custom verifier factories and saved

The CPU CLI checks in `open_instruct/test_miles_package_layout.py` run without
site-packages. `tests/miles/test_package_layout.py` resolves hooks supplied by
both repositories inside the pinned runtime.

### Application callbacks and CPU tools

The backend trainer and managed rollout modules do not import Open Instruct.
Open Instruct supplies `core_records_factory` for per-question recording and
`core_evaluation_snapshot` for requested post-update HF exports. Those callbacks
preserve the existing recording and evaluation schedules. Dataset preparation,
reward callbacks, data-source selection, Beaker launch and evaluation submission
remain application-owned. The native `olmo_core` argument loader still resolves

Small CPU planning and artifact-reader helpers remain local so `plan`, `validate`
and offline analysis work without the private runtime. Runtime integration tests
compare their algorithms with the MILES counterparts: scoring policy, capacity
reporting, timeout diagnostics, atomic JSON publication, input validation and
throughput arithmetic.

## Core runtime compatibility

The `olmo-core` revision in
[`runtime.lock.json`](../../runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json) is the Core source used
by the runtime. The adapter interfaces it relies on were merged in
[OLMo-core PR #888](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/pull/888). The runtime pins
merge commit `6ceda6530625caa5d23e3be8a455c600f62a7338`, including the reviewed

Core's routed-expert `match_eager_rounding` defaults to false. The pinned MILES
adapter explicitly enables it for policy scoring and accepts legacy MILES

Core's PR checks and application validation cover different boundaries.
Rebuild runtime/application images from the lock and validate the intended

1	# u8-l1 MILES 总览与架构分层
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 说出 MILES 与 `grpo.py`（Core/vLLM）、`grpo_fast.py`（DeepSpeed/vLLM）三条 RL 训练路线的关系与各自适用范围。
8	2. 理解 MILES 的所有权分层：open-instruct 包装层负责什么、MILES 运行时负责什么、Core 适配器经 OLMo-core 与 SGLang 又负责什么。
9	3. 会用 `python -m open_instruct.miles` 的五个子命令（`plan` / `validate` / `train` / `run` / `status`）以及 `records` 记录分析工具。
10	4. 知道维护示例按模型家族组织在 `configs/miles/examples/tiny/` 与 `configs/miles/examples/small/` 下：tiny 家族是力学/学习示例，small 家族在上一轮（PR #2280）从 dev 占位副本升级为实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 三档配方（two-node-mech / four-node / eight-node），且全部维护示例的损失基线已翻转为 token-mean（PR #2271）。
11	5. 掌握本轮（PR #2289，提交 27f868159）固化的**学习示例恢复保存基线**：Tiny node/three-node 与 Small four/eight-node 统一为每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、外加 50/100 更新里程碑与最终存档，Small four/eight-node 从「禁用保存、不自动恢复」翻转为启用；本轮 #2293 还把 Small 三份配方的心跳超时从 120 升到 480 秒、MILES 运行时 pin 升至 9eff46a4。
12	6. 了解文档地图的扩展脉络：`grading.md` 与 `abstention.md`（上一轮）、`olmo35-small.md`（上一轮）及其本轮新增的「Checkpoint settings in the current starters」一节，以及 examples README 本轮新增的「Recovery checkpoints and preserved milestones」共享策略节。
13	
14	本讲是 MILES 单元（u8）的第一篇，只做总览不深入细节；配置系统、工作流执行、奖励体系分别在 u8-l2、u8-l3、u8-l6 及之后各讲展开，Small B300 配方的显存账目与吞吐审计另立一讲（u8-l15）。
15	
16	## 2. 前置知识
17	
18	阅读本讲前，建议先具备以下概念（不熟悉也没关系，下面用通俗语言解释）：
19	
20	- **RLVR / GRPO**：可验证奖励强化学习（RL with Verifiable Rewards）。对数学题、代码这类有标准答案的任务，可以用一个「验证器」自动判分作为奖励，而不需要训练额外的奖励模型。GRPO 是一种组相对策略优化算法：对同一个 prompt 采样一组回答，按组内奖励的相对高低计算优势。已在 u6-l1、u6-l2 讲过。
21	- **rollout（rollout 编排）**：RL 训练的一步是「让当前策略生成一批回答 → 判分 → 用结果更新策略」。生成这批回答的过程及其调度（队列、准入、引擎管理）称为 rollout 编排。
22	- **Ray actor**：Ray 分布式框架中的常驻进程，持有 GPU 资源并响应远程调用。MILES 运行时用 Ray actor 承载训练器与推理引擎。
23	- **OLMo-core 与 SGLang**：OLMo-core 是 Allen AI 的模型与分布式训练库（提供模型结构、checkpoint、分布式原语）；SGLang 是推理服务框架。MILES 用前者训练、后者服务。
24	- **TOML run 文件**：MILES 用一个结构化 TOML 文件描述一次完整运行（模型、数据、拓扑、启动、追踪等），是所有子命令的输入。
25	- **token-mean 与 response-mean 损失加权**：一个批次里有长有短的回答。response-mean（按响应平均）给每个回答同等权重，长回答里的每个 token 影响被稀释；token-mean（按 token 平均，`calculate_per_token_loss=true`）给每个 token 同等权重。维护示例统一采用 token-mean，但省略该设置时库默认仍是 response-mean，以兼容既有 run。
26	- **有界恢复保存与永久里程碑（bounded recovery saves / preserved milestones）**：RL 训练一次运行数小时到数天，被抢占或中断后要能从最近的完整存档恢复。「有界」指普通恢复保存滚动保留最近 N 份（磁盘占用不随时间无限增长）；「里程碑」（`checkpoint_keep_every`）指每隔更长的更新间隔**永久**保留一份，供扩展运行与事后回溯；另有 `save_final_checkpoint` 在结束时落最终存档。本轮 #2289 把学习型模板统一到「每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、50 或 100 更新里程碑 + 最终存档」。
27	- **心跳超时（heartbeat_timeout）与受保护最短运行时（min_runtime）**：Beaker 集群上驱动进程靠心跳向监控证明自己还活着，超时（本轮 Small 配方从 120 秒升至 480 秒）会被判定为僵死；`min_runtime` 是调度器保证分配的受保护时长。恢复保存的节奏必须与这两者配合——首个完整恢复保存应落在受保护时长之内。
28	- **B300 与 MoE**：B300 是 NVIDIA 的 Blackwell Ultra 数据中心 GPU（AI2 的 Holmes 集群使用）；MoE（混合专家）模型每个 token 只激活部分专家参数。OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）是 256 专家、约 0.8B 激活参数的小型 MoE 模型。
29	- **Beaker**：AI2 的实验平台，MILES 的 `run` 子命令把 TOML 编译成 Beaker 实验提交。不熟悉 Beaker 也不影响本讲，详见 u8-l8。

46	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
47	
48	### 4.1 CLI 入口：`python -m open_instruct.miles`
49	
50	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
51	
52	MILES 在 open-instruct 中的公开入口只有一条命令：`python -m open_instruct.miles`。它把「规划、校验、本地执行、Beaker 提交、状态查询」以及「推理记录分析」全部收拢到一个入口后面。
53	
54	为什么这样设计？
55	
56	- **研究者的全部意图浓缩在一个 TOML run 文件里**。同一条命令对不同子命令复用同一份配置，避免「训练用一套脚本、提交用另一套脚本」的漂移。
57	- **运行时导入是延迟的**。GPU/MILES 运行时只在真正需要的子命令里才 import，因此 `plan` / `validate` 这类规划命令在没有 GPU、没有安装 MILES 私有运行时的笔记本电脑上也能运行。这一点是文档明确承诺的：[docs/miles/index.md:L21-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L21-L23) 写明 "Planning does not require GPUs or mounted checkpoints"。
58	
59	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
60	
61	CLI 的一次执行流程：
62	
63	```text
64	python -m open_instruct.miles COMMAND CONFIG.toml [--set SECTION.KEY=VALUE ...]
65	        │
66	        ├─ sys.argv[1] == "records"？
67	        │    ├─ "select"        → open_instruct.miles.datasets.record_selection
68	        │    ├─ "replay-pool"   → open_instruct.miles.datasets.replay_summary
69	        │    └─ 其他            → miles.utils.record_summary（需 MILES 运行时）
70	        │
71	        └─ 否则：argparse 解析 COMMAND ∈ {plan, validate, train, run, status}
72	             │
73	             ├─ 读取 TOML → payload
74	             ├─ 判断结构化：payload 含 schema_version 或 model 字段？
75	             │    ├─ 是 → specs.from_dict(...) 解析为 RunSpec（结构化 run 文件）
76	             │    └─ 否 → RunConfig.from_dict(...)（低层原始配置）
77	             │
78	             └─ 按命令分发：
79	                  plan     → config.plan()，打印计划 JSON + 提示（advisories）
80	                  validate → 结构化：plan() 全量校验；原始：parse_runtime()
81	                  run      → execution.launch.run()（提交 Beaker，仅限结构化）
82	                  status   → execution.launch.status()（仅限结构化）
83	                  train    → workflow.execute(config)（结构化）/ train_config（原始）
84	                             （OPDRunSpec 走独立的 distillation.opd_runtime 路径）
85	```
86	
87	注意两个设计点：
88	
89	1. **结构化 run 文件与低层配置双轨**。`run`/`status` 只接受 `schema_version=1` 的结构化文件；低层原始配置只支持 `plan`/`validate`/`train`。这让「研究者视角的完整 run」与「底层调参视角的 CoreConfig」都能进门，但提交必须走结构化路线。
90	2. **错误处理友好**。输入错误（`InputError`）默认被转成一行 `parser.error` 提示而不是一长串 traceback，加 `--debug` 才展开。

140	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
141	
142	**练习 1**：为什么 `run`/`status` 拒绝低层原始配置（`RunConfig`），只接受 `schema_version=1` 的结构化文件？
143	
144	**参考答案**：`run` 要把「模型、数据、拓扑、启动、挂载」完整编译成 Beaker 实验，这些信息只有结构化 RunSpec 才齐备；低层 `RunConfig` 只描述训练器参数，缺少提交所需的 launch/output 等段落。源码在 [open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L79-L81](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L79-L81) 显式报错。
145	
146	**练习 2**：`python -m open_instruct.miles records summarize` 与 `plan` 对运行环境的依赖有何不同？
147	
148	**参考答案**：`records summarize` 分发到 MILES 包内的 `miles.utils.record_summary`，需要安装 MILES 私有运行时（缺失时报「requires the MILES package」）；`plan` 只依赖 open-instruct 的 CPU 配置代码，无需 GPU 栈。见 [open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L27-L44](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L27-L44)。
149	
150	**练习 3**：`--set name=my-run` 这样的覆盖发生在哪个阶段？与直接改 TOML 有何区别？
151	
152	**参考答案**：覆盖作为 `overrides` 参数传给 `specs.from_dict` / `RunConfig.from_dict`（[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L69-L73](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L69-L73)），在解析时叠加到 TOML 文档之上。区别：TOML 文件保持原样（可继续作为版本化的基准），覆盖只影响这一次调用，适合临时调参、sweep 与调试。
153	
154	### 4.2 架构分层：三层所有权与适配器包布局
155	
156	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
157	
158	MILES 不是「又一个训练脚本」，而是把一次 RL 运行拆给三个所有者：
159	
160	- **open-instruct 包装层**：研究者面对的一切——配置校验、数据准备、验证器/奖励、Beaker 提交与回执、运行产物。
161	- **MILES 运行时**（私有、按锁定制）：rollout actor、SGLang 推理引擎、采样/优势/损失机制、共享传输。
162	- **Core 适配器**（位于 MILES 内）：模型构建、打分与训练前向、梯度同步、优化器与 checkpoint、权重导出；训练走 OLMo-core，服务走 SGLang。
163	
164	为什么要有这条边界？因为 open-instruct 是公开研究仓库，而 MILES 运行时（含其 pinned fork）是独立发布的私有组件。open-instruct 负责「研究者想要什么」，MILES 负责「RL 机制怎么做」，Core 适配器负责「在 OLMo-core 上真正训练」。理解这条边界后，你在 open-instruct 仓库里看到的每个 `open_instruct/miles/` 子包都能归位到某一层。
165	
166	同时要记住：**MILES 不取代既有 GRPO 训练器**。`grpo.py`（Core/vLLM）与 `grpo_fast.py`（DeepSpeed/vLLM，u6-l4 讲过其 Ray 拓扑）仍是稠密模型训练与历史复现的现行选择；MILES 面向受支持的 Olmo MoE 模型（也提供稠密 Olmo 3 适配器，但验证较少）。
167	
168	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
169	
170	一次 MILES 运行的纵向视角：
171	
172	```text
173	研究者编写 run.toml（schema_version=1）
174	        │  python -m open_instruct.miles plan / validate      ← open-instruct：CPU 校验与规划
175	        ▼
176	RunSpec ──编译──▶ RunConfig（含 CoreConfig 与原生 MILES 选项）
177	        │  python -m open_instruct.miles run                  ← open-instruct：编译 Beaker 实验并提交
178	        ▼
179	Beaker 上的应用镜像（按 runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json 构建）
180	        │
181	        ▼
182	MILES 运行时启动：Ray 集群、裁判加载、工作流准备并发启动
183	        │
184	        ▼
185	Core 适配器（OLMoCoreTrainRayActor）：SGLang 服务策略 → rollout → 打分 →
186	OLMo-core 训练前向/反向 → 权重发布（refresh/barrier/engine_drain）→ checkpoint/导出
187	```
188	
189	分层所有权表（五层，前三层是所有权划分，后两层是上游基座）：
190	
191	| 层 | 拥有 |
192	|---|---|
193	| Open Instruct 包装层 | 配置校验、准备、验证器、提交/回执、运行产物 |
194	| MILES 运行时 | rollout actor、SGLang 引擎、采样/优势/损失机制、共享传输助手 |
195	| Core 适配器（在 MILES 中） | 模型构建、文档/回放对齐、打分与训练前向、梯度同步、优化器/checkpoint、张量导出 |
196	| OLMo-core | 模型与分布式训练原语、注意力/专家执行 |
197	| olmo-sglang | 服务架构注册与模型专属执行 |
198

246	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
247	
248	**练习 1**：MILES 与 `grpo_fast.py` 都用 Ray + 多进程做 RL，本质区别是什么？
249	
250	**参考答案**：`grpo_fast.py` 是 open-instruct 仓库内的一个完整训练脚本（DeepSpeed 训练器 + vLLM 引擎，代码全部在本仓库，u6-l4）；MILES 把「rollout 编排与共享 RL 机制」交给私有 MILES 运行时（按 `runtime.lock.json` 锁定），open-instruct 只保留配置/数据/奖励集成与提交，训练走 OLMo-core、服务走 SGLang。另见 [docs/miles/index.md:L8-L13](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L8-L13)：引入 MILES 不弃用既有 GRPO 训练器。
251	
252	**练习 2**：如果要在 MILES 训练中新增一种自定义验证器，改动应落在哪一层？为什么？
253	
254	**参考答案**：落在 open-instruct 包装层的 `open_instruct/miles/rewards/`（验证器、奖励路由与托管裁判），以可信注册表条目（factory + 配置）暴露给 MILES。因为后端训练器与托管 rollout 模块不导入 open-instruct（[docs/miles/architecture.md:L304-L313](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L304-L313)），MILES 侧只通过约定路径消费应用侧回调与注册表。（验证器细节见 u8-l6。）
255	
256	**练习 3**：为什么 open-instruct 的普通 `uv.lock` 环境跑不了 MILES 训练，而 `plan` 却能跑？本轮运行时锁前进后，旧镜像还能继续用吗？
257	
258	**参考答案**：训练需要 MILES 私有运行时、SGLang 与锁定版本的 OLMo-core，这些由 `runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json` 与专用应用镜像提供（[docs/miles/architecture.md:L25-L30](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L25-L30)、[docs/miles/architecture.md:L179-L193](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L179-L193)）；`plan` 只走 CPU 配置代码，CLI 把运行时 import 延迟到需要它的命令（[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L4-L5](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L4-L5)）。旧镜像不可靠：锁的 revision 已从 22d2fb4c 升到 9eff46a4（[runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json:L13-L16](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json#L13-L16)），examples README 明确提醒 launcher 只核对镜像 ID、不核对镜像内源码是否匹配当前锁，应核对镜像构建记录或直接重建（[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L83-L91](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L83-L91)）。

366	### 4.4 示例家族划分：tiny 与 small
367	
368	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
369	
370	维护示例（maintained examples）是 MILES 的「配置基线」：除非 run 明确声明，应以示例为准。示例按**模型家族**重组为 `tiny/` 与 `small/` 两个目录，近两轮这两个家族的分工与基线发生了两次实质变化：
371	
372	- **tiny 家族**：微型模型的力学/学习示例——`dev.toml`（单 GPU 共置力学检查）、`node.toml`（单节点学习）、`three-node.toml`（三节点学习 + 后台评估）。上一轮统一了 Tiny 学习基线：256 prompts × 8 responses、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6 无 warmup、token-mean loss；本轮 #2289 又统一了恢复保存基线：每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、node 按 50 更新留里程碑（与既有的 50 更新开发面板对齐）、three-node 按 100 更新留里程碑，外加最终存档。
373	- **small 家族**：上一轮删除 `small/dev.toml` 占位，换成**实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B，KDA + 256 专家 MoE）B300 三档配方**：`two-node-mech.toml`（两节点力学检查，4 次更新，仍不保存 checkpoint）、`four-node.toml` 与 `eight-node.toml`（30 更新起步预算布局，本轮从「禁用保存、不自动恢复」翻转为启用与 Tiny 相同的有界恢复保存 + `auto_resume = true`）。
374	
375	同时，**全部维护示例的损失基线从 per-response 翻转为 token-mean**：`miles.calculate_per_token_loss = true`。注意省略该设置时库默认仍是 `false`（response-mean），这是为兼容既有 run 而刻意保留的——所以每个示例都把它显式写出。
376	
377	为什么按模型家族分目录？因为 serving 几何、显存账目、准入参数都是模型专属的：Small 文档明确告诫「不要把 Tiny 的 12.5B 推理 preset、评估 profile 或缓存几何复制进 Small」。
378	
379	本轮还有一个容易被忽略的运维细节：#2293 把三份 Small 配方的 `heartbeat_timeout` 从 120 秒升到 480 秒——启用恢复保存与自动重启后，保存/恢复期间驱动可能长时间不发包，过紧的心跳会被误判为僵死（恢复语义详见 u8-l3）。
380	
381	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
382	
383	当前六份维护示例的分工（与 README 表格一致，最后一列是本轮 #2289 固化的恢复保存基线）：
384	
385	| 配置 | 家族 | 用途 | 恢复保存基线 |
386	|---|---|---|---|
387	| `tiny/dev.toml` | tiny | 单 GPU、训练/推理共置；GSM8K 短力学检查 | 独立短跑设置（保留原样） |
388	| `tiny/node.toml` | tiny | 单个 8 GPU 节点：2 训练 GPU（EP2）+ 6 推理引擎；无裁判 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 50 更新里程碑 + 最终存档 |
389	| `tiny/three-node.toml` | tiny | 三节点学习：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、15 推理引擎 + 1 裁判；24 GPU，另加后台评估 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 100 更新里程碑 + 最终存档 |
390	| `small/two-node-mech.toml` | small | OLMo 3.5 Small 力学检查：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、7 引擎、1 裁判；4 次更新 | 不保存、不自动恢复（保持不变） |
391	| `small/four-node.toml` | small | Small 起步预算布局：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、23 引擎（R=96）、1 裁判；审计中位数约 302 s/更新 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 50 里程碑 + 最终存档；`auto_resume = true` |
392	| `small/eight-node.toml` | small | Small 起步预算布局：16 训练 GPU（2 × EP8）、47 引擎（R=96）、1 裁判；晚期窗口中位数约 185 s/更新 | 同 four-node |
393	
394	近两轮基线变化的要点：
395	
396	```text
397	损失加权（上一轮 #2271）：
398	            per-response（response-mean）      →  token-mean（calculate_per_token_loss = true）
399	           （省略该设置时库默认仍为 response-mean，兼容既有 run）
400	
401	Tiny 学习（上一轮 #2271）：
402	            128 prompts × 8，batch 1024        →  256 prompts × 8，batch 2048
403	学习率：    （模板未显式设置）                  →  learning_rate = 6e-6，恒定、无 warmup
404	
405	small 家族（上一轮 #2280）：
406	            small/dev.toml（tiny dev 的占位副本）→  三份实测 B300 配方 + docs/miles/olmo35-small.md
407	                                                +  configs/miles/moe_configs/（fused-MoE tile 调优）
408	
409	学习示例恢复保存（本轮 #2289）：
410	            Tiny 学习模板 save_interval = 25    →  save_interval = 10 + checkpoint_keep_last = 2
411	                                                    + checkpoint_keep_every（node/Small=50，three-node=100）
412	                                                    + save_final_checkpoint = true
413	            Small four/eight-node：              →  启用上述保存基线 + auto_resume = true
414	            save_checkpoints = false、auto_resume = false
415	
416	心跳超时（本轮 #2293）：
417	            Small 三份配方 heartbeat_timeout     →  480 秒（原 120 秒）
418	```
419	
420	两个容易踩的陷阱：
421	
422	1. **历史上的 Small 吞吐计时用的是旧设置**（batch 1024、LR 1e-6、response-mean，且未启用 code grading），且全部是**关闭保存**的运行——不含保存 I/O 开销。新基线（含每 10 更新的保存）不可直接沿用旧数字。
423	2. **里程碑间隔是「为扩展预留」的**：30 更新起步预算下，50/100 里程碑不会在本次运行内触发；它们只在把 `num_rollouts` 扩大后才生效。README 因此提醒：无 checkpoint 的计时实验要显式关掉保存与自动恢复并删掉 `save_interval`，且不要把该覆盖带进学习 run。
424

426	
427	示例 README 开头声明家族划分：`small` 家族持有实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 布局并链接配方文档：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L1-L6](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L1-L6)。
428	
429	六份配置的用途表：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L8-L15](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L8-L15)。紧接着的两段给出选择规则与基线对齐告诫：力学检查用 `tiny/dev.toml`（Tiny）或 `small/two-node-mech.toml`（Small），**Small 没有单 GPU 训练配方、两节点是其最小已测配置**（L17-L19）；三份 Small 配方统一采用 PR #2271 的 Tiny 学习基线（256 × 8、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6、token-mean），而报告的 Small 计时用的是 batch 1024 / LR 1e-6 / response-mean（L21-L25）。
430	
431	基线声明段：除非明确声明否则以示例为准，尤其保持 `miles.calculate_per_token_loss=true`、`core.reward_zero_truncated=true`、`core.reward_final_answer_only=true` 与 `core.reward_reasoning_mode="required"`：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L31-L42](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L31-L42)。
432	
433	**本轮新增的共享恢复策略节**是理解 checkpoint 基线的入口：开头一段总括「Tiny 学习与 Small four/eight-node 模板启用每 10 更新的原生恢复保存、保留最近两份、永久里程碑 + 最终存档、启用自动恢复；短力学示例保持各自的独立设置」：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L328-L333](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L328-L333)。随后是一张四列表，逐模板给出恢复间隔、里程碑间隔与理由（node 的 50 对齐既有开发面板、three-node 的 100 保留更长学习里程碑、Small 的 50 为扩展 30 更新预算预留）：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L335-L339](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L335-L339)。间隔选择指南在 L341-L348：按实测墙钟更新时间选间隔、目标约 1-2 小时一次保存（Tiny seed17 数据在 batch 2048 下约 5-7 分钟/更新，即每 10 更新约 50-70 分钟）、这是工作负载特定的证据而非普适吞吐声明、Small 历史计时不含保存 I/O。启动前预算与恢复验证清单在 L350-L364：分开预算启动/编译/生成等待/训练/评估/保存时间，**确保首个完整恢复保存从容落在受保护最短运行时之内**；恢复后核对完成清单、最新指针与数据游标哈希、首个恢复后优化器计数与游标一致性；「自动任务重启本身不证明模型/优化器恢复」。

497	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
498	
499	**练习 1**：`tiny/` 与 `small/` 两个家族各自的分工是什么？为什么 Small 没有单 GPU 训练配方？
500	
501	**参考答案**：`tiny/` 是 Tiny 微型模型的力学检查（dev）与学习示例（node/three-node）；`small/` 是实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 布局：two-node-mech 做力学检查，four/eight-node 做起步预算布局。Small 没有单 GPU 训练配方、两节点（8 训练 GPU + 7 引擎 + 1 裁判）是其最小已测配置——见 [configs/miles/examples/README.md:L17-L19](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L17-L19)。
502	
503	**练习 2**：示例都写了 `calculate_per_token_loss = true`，为什么库默认仍是 `false`？这两者矛盾吗？
504	
505	**参考答案**：不矛盾。库默认保留 response-mean 是为了兼容既有 run——省略该设置的老配置行为不变；维护示例显式设 `true` 是把新基线写清楚，避免「沉默改变目标」。development-defaults 同样写明「Omitted library settings retain response-mean weighting for compatibility」（Loss weighting 条目，其上一条即 Tiny learning batch and LR）：[docs/miles/development-defaults.md:L18-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/development-defaults.md#L18-L23)。
506	
507	**练习 3**：Small four/eight-node 的 30 更新预算下，保存点落在哪里？50 更新里程碑有什么用？为什么 README 要求「首个完整恢复保存应落在受保护最短运行时之内」？
508	
509	**参考答案**：`save_interval = 10` 且启用最终存档，30 更新预算在 10/20/30 三处保存；`checkpoint_keep_every = 50` 在本次起步预算内不会触发，它是为把 `num_rollouts` 扩大后的长运行预留的永久里程碑（见 [docs/miles/olmo35-small.md:L235-L238](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/olmo35-small.md#L235-L238)）。受保护最短运行时是调度器保证的连续执行窗口：若首个完整保存来不及在窗口内落盘，一次抢占就会让整个 run 从零开始，恢复保存形同虚设；因此间隔要从实测墙钟时间选（目标约 1-2 小时一次，Tiny seed17 约 5-7 分钟/更新即约 50-70 分钟/10 更新），放不进就缩短间隔或修改预算（[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L341-L356](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L341-L356)）。另注意历史 Small 计时是关闭保存的运行，不含保存 I/O 开销，不能直接当作当前配方的 checkpoint 预测。

523	6. **验证笔记**：用只读命令抽查你的连线，例如 `ls open_instruct/miles/rewards/`（验证器确实在包装层）、`grep -n "runtime.lock.json" docs/miles/architecture.md`（运行时锁的权威位置）、`grep -n "save_interval\|checkpoint_keep_every" configs/miles/examples/*/*.toml`（恢复保存基线的落点）。
524	
525	预期产物：一张三层架构图 + 一页所有权笔记 + 一份 `plan` 输出的对照标注 + 四行家族对照。`plan` 的具体输出本讲未实际执行，**待本地验证**；若 `plan` 因占位路径报提示，记录提示内容并继续——规划本身不需要那些挂载存在。
526	
527	## 6. 本讲小结
528	
529	- **入口唯一**：`python -m open_instruct.miles` 暴露五个子命令 `plan/validate/train/run/status`（另有 `records` 记录分析）；运行时导入延迟到需要的命令，`plan`/`validate` 无 GPU、无 MILES 运行时即可运行。
530	- **结构化双轨**：含 `schema_version` 或 `model` 的 TOML 编译为 RunSpec（`run`/`status` 只接受这种）；低层 RunConfig 仅供 `plan`/`validate`/`train`。
531	- **三层所有权**：open-instruct 包装层管配置/数据/奖励/提交；MILES 运行时管 rollout 编排与共享 RL 机制；Core 适配器经 OLMo-core 训练、SGLang 服务。后端不导入 open-instruct，open-instruct 以回调与可信注册表注入能力。
532	- **不弃用旧路线**：`grpo.py` 与 `grpo_fast.py` 仍是稠密模型与历史复现的现行选择；MILES 面向受支持的 Olmo MoE 模型。
533	- **文档地图持续扩展**：`grading.md`（共享判分输入）、`abstention.md`（Nemotron 弃答 QA）、`olmo35-small.md`（B300 实测配方文档，入 mkdocs 导航）、`managed-judges.md` 的未使用绑定规则、grpo/development-defaults/run-controls/throughput-profiles 的 token-mean 措辞；本轮再添 examples README 的「Recovery checkpoints and preserved milestones」节、olmo35-small 的「Checkpoint settings in the current starters」节与 development-defaults 的 Native checkpoints 改写。首页表格是精选而非穷举，且同一文档内应以更晚、更具体的章节为准。
534	- **示例家族与基线**：`small/dev.toml` 占位已删除，small 家族是实测 OLMo 3.5 Small B300 三档配方（two-node-mech/four-node/eight-node，配套 moe_configs tile 调优）；全部维护示例统一 token-mean loss，Tiny 学习基线为 256 prompts × 8、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6。本轮 #2289 为学习型模板固化有界恢复保存（每 10 更新、保留 2 份、50/100 里程碑、最终存档，Small four/eight-node 翻转为启用 + `auto_resume=true`），#2293 把 Small 心跳升至 480 秒并推进 MILES 运行时 pin（9eff46a4）。配置字段细节见 u8-l2，恢复语义见 u8-l3，B300 深读见 u8-l15。
535	
536	## 7. 下一步学习建议
537	
538	下一讲 **u8-l2（配置系统：TOML → RunSpec → RunConfig）** 将拆开本讲只碰了一下的编译链：`configuration/run_spec.py` 的加载与编译、CoreConfig/RunConfig 如何编译出参数列表并挂接奖励/数据钩子、constraints 驱动的校验，以及示例基线（`calculate_per_token_loss=true` 与本轮的 `save_interval`/`checkpoint_keep_last`/`checkpoint_keep_every`/`save_final_checkpoint` 字段族）在配置层的含义。
539	
540	在进入下一讲之前，建议先做两件源码阅读：
541	
542	1. 浏览 `open_instruct/miles/configuration/` 目录（`ls` 即可），对照 [docs/miles/architecture.md:L276-L291](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L276-L291) 的职责表建立印象。
543	2. 通读 [docs/miles/workflow.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/workflow.md)（配合 u8-l3），了解一次 run 从准备、训练到导出的阶段划分与本轮 #2293 的恢复/心跳变化，为后续所有 MILES 讲义提供骨架。

# u8-l1 MILES 总览与架构分层

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 MILES 与 `grpo.py`（Core/vLLM）、`grpo_fast.py`（DeepSpeed/vLLM）三条 RL 训练路线的关系与各自适用范围。
2. 理解 MILES 的所有权分层：open-instruct 包装层负责什么、MILES 运行时负责什么、Core 适配器经 OLMo-core 与 SGLang 又负责什么。
3. 会用 `python -m open_instruct.miles` 的五个子命令（`plan` / `validate` / `train` / `run` / `status`）以及 `records` 记录分析工具。
4. 知道维护示例按模型家族组织在 `configs/miles/examples/tiny/` 与 `configs/miles/examples/small/` 下：tiny 家族是力学/学习示例，small 家族在上一轮（PR #2280）从 dev 占位副本升级为实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 三档配方（two-node-mech / four-node / eight-node），且全部维护示例的损失基线已翻转为 token-mean（PR #2271）。
5. 掌握本轮（PR #2289，提交 27f868159）固化的**学习示例恢复保存基线**：Tiny node/three-node 与 Small four/eight-node 统一为每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、外加 50/100 更新里程碑与最终存档，Small four/eight-node 从「禁用保存、不自动恢复」翻转为启用；本轮 #2293 还把 Small 三份配方的心跳超时从 120 升到 480 秒、MILES 运行时 pin 升至 9eff46a4。
6. 了解文档地图的扩展脉络：`grading.md` 与 `abstention.md`（上一轮）、`olmo35-small.md`（上一轮）及其本轮新增的「Checkpoint settings in the current starters」一节，以及 examples README 本轮新增的「Recovery checkpoints and preserved milestones」共享策略节。

本讲是 MILES 单元（u8）的第一篇，只做总览不深入细节；配置系统、工作流执行、奖励体系分别在 u8-l2、u8-l3、u8-l6 及之后各讲展开，Small B300 配方的显存账目与吞吐审计另立一讲（u8-l15）。

## 2. 前置知识

阅读本讲前，建议先具备以下概念（不熟悉也没关系，下面用通俗语言解释）：

- **RLVR / GRPO**：可验证奖励强化学习（RL with Verifiable Rewards）。对数学题、代码这类有标准答案的任务，可以用一个「验证器」自动判分作为奖励，而不需要训练额外的奖励模型。GRPO 是一种组相对策略优化算法：对同一个 prompt 采样一组回答，按组内奖励的相对高低计算优势。已在 u6-l1、u6-l2 讲过。
- **rollout（rollout 编排）**：RL 训练的一步是「让当前策略生成一批回答 → 判分 → 用结果更新策略」。生成这批回答的过程及其调度（队列、准入、引擎管理）称为 rollout 编排。
- **Ray actor**：Ray 分布式框架中的常驻进程，持有 GPU 资源并响应远程调用。MILES 运行时用 Ray actor 承载训练器与推理引擎。
- **OLMo-core 与 SGLang**：OLMo-core 是 Allen AI 的模型与分布式训练库（提供模型结构、checkpoint、分布式原语）；SGLang 是推理服务框架。MILES 用前者训练、后者服务。
- **TOML run 文件**：MILES 用一个结构化 TOML 文件描述一次完整运行（模型、数据、拓扑、启动、追踪等），是所有子命令的输入。
- **token-mean 与 response-mean 损失加权**：一个批次里有长有短的回答。response-mean（按响应平均）给每个回答同等权重，长回答里的每个 token 影响被稀释；token-mean（按 token 平均，`calculate_per_token_loss=true`）给每个 token 同等权重。维护示例统一采用 token-mean，但省略该设置时库默认仍是 response-mean，以兼容既有 run。
- **有界恢复保存与永久里程碑（bounded recovery saves / preserved milestones）**：RL 训练一次运行数小时到数天，被抢占或中断后要能从最近的完整存档恢复。「有界」指普通恢复保存滚动保留最近 N 份（磁盘占用不随时间无限增长）；「里程碑」（`checkpoint_keep_every`）指每隔更长的更新间隔**永久**保留一份，供扩展运行与事后回溯；另有 `save_final_checkpoint` 在结束时落最终存档。本轮 #2289 把学习型模板统一到「每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、50 或 100 更新里程碑 + 最终存档」。
- **心跳超时（heartbeat_timeout）与受保护最短运行时（min_runtime）**：Beaker 集群上驱动进程靠心跳向监控证明自己还活着，超时（本轮 Small 配方从 120 秒升至 480 秒）会被判定为僵死；`min_runtime` 是调度器保证分配的受保护时长。恢复保存的节奏必须与这两者配合——首个完整恢复保存应落在受保护时长之内。
- **B300 与 MoE**：B300 是 NVIDIA 的 Blackwell Ultra 数据中心 GPU（AI2 的 Holmes 集群使用）；MoE（混合专家）模型每个 token 只激活部分专家参数。OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）是 256 专家、约 0.8B 激活参数的小型 MoE 模型。
- **Beaker**：AI2 的实验平台，MILES 的 `run` 子命令把 TOML 编译成 Beaker 实验提交。不熟悉 Beaker 也不影响本讲，详见 u8-l8。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [docs/miles/index.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md) | MILES 文档首页：定位声明、入门顺序、文档地图表、权威性与维护规则 |
| [docs/miles/architecture.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md) | 架构与开发：分层所有权表、运行时锁与镜像、启动依赖、本地开发检查、适配器包布局 |
| [open_instruct/miles/__main__.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py) | CLI 入口：`python -m open_instruct.miles`，加载 run 文件并分发 plan/validate/train/run/status 与 records |
| [docs/miles/grpo.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/grpo.md) | MILES GRPO 指南：首次运行步骤、配置约定、判分/截断/未判分语义、发布模式 |
| [configs/miles/examples/README.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md) | 维护示例的导读：按模型家族分组（tiny/small），六份模板的用途、基线设置，以及本轮新增的「Recovery checkpoints and preserved milestones」共享恢复策略 |
| [configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml) | 单 GPU 共置（colocated）微型模型力学检查模板，本讲实践对象 |
| [docs/miles/olmo35-small.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/olmo35-small.md) | OLMo 3.5 Small B300 实测布局、显存账目、吞吐审计与失败记录；本轮新增「Checkpoint settings in the current starters」一节 |
| [configs/miles/moe_configs/README.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/moe_configs/README.md) | SGLang fused-MoE tile 调优文件的生成、分发与版本匹配规则 |
| [docs/miles/grading.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/grading.md) | 共享判分输入（ResponseParts、objective/scope/require_response 契约）与行为变更登记 |
| [docs/miles/abstention.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/abstention.md) | Nemotron 弃答式 QA 奖励的语义、rubric 与裁判服务复用 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 CLI 入口：`python -m open_instruct.miles`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

MILES 在 open-instruct 中的公开入口只有一条命令：`python -m open_instruct.miles`。它把「规划、校验、本地执行、Beaker 提交、状态查询」以及「推理记录分析」全部收拢到一个入口后面。

为什么这样设计？

- **研究者的全部意图浓缩在一个 TOML run 文件里**。同一条命令对不同子命令复用同一份配置，避免「训练用一套脚本、提交用另一套脚本」的漂移。
- **运行时导入是延迟的**。GPU/MILES 运行时只在真正需要的子命令里才 import，因此 `plan` / `validate` 这类规划命令在没有 GPU、没有安装 MILES 私有运行时的笔记本电脑上也能运行。这一点是文档明确承诺的：[docs/miles/index.md:L21-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L21-L23) 写明 "Planning does not require GPUs or mounted checkpoints"。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

CLI 的一次执行流程：

```text
python -m open_instruct.miles COMMAND CONFIG.toml [--set SECTION.KEY=VALUE ...]
        │
        ├─ sys.argv[1] == "records"？
        │    ├─ "select"        → open_instruct.miles.datasets.record_selection
        │    ├─ "replay-pool"   → open_instruct.miles.datasets.replay_summary
        │    └─ 其他            → miles.utils.record_summary（需 MILES 运行时）
        │
        └─ 否则：argparse 解析 COMMAND ∈ {plan, validate, train, run, status}
             │
             ├─ 读取 TOML → payload
             ├─ 判断结构化：payload 含 schema_version 或 model 字段？
             │    ├─ 是 → specs.from_dict(...) 解析为 RunSpec（结构化 run 文件）
             │    └─ 否 → RunConfig.from_dict(...)（低层原始配置）
             │
             └─ 按命令分发：
                  plan     → config.plan()，打印计划 JSON + 提示（advisories）
                  validate → 结构化：plan() 全量校验；原始：parse_runtime()
                  run      → execution.launch.run()（提交 Beaker，仅限结构化）
                  status   → execution.launch.status()（仅限结构化）
                  train    → workflow.execute(config)（结构化）/ train_config（原始）
                             （OPDRunSpec 走独立的 distillation.opd_runtime 路径）
```

注意两个设计点：

1. **结构化 run 文件与低层配置双轨**。`run`/`status` 只接受 `schema_version=1` 的结构化文件；低层原始配置只支持 `plan`/`validate`/`train`。这让「研究者视角的完整 run」与「底层调参视角的 CoreConfig」都能进门，但提交必须走结构化路线。
2. **错误处理友好**。输入错误（`InputError`）默认被转成一行 `parser.error` 提示而不是一长串 traceback，加 `--debug` 才展开。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

> 近两轮提交（#2271/#2280/#2286 与本轮 #2289/#2293）均未改动此文件，行号与上一版讲义一致。

模块 docstring 即是命令速查，明确写出五个子命令与 records 的用法：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L1-L12](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L1-L12)。其中 L4-L5 说明「运行时导入延迟到需要它的命令，规划无需 GPU 栈」这一关键约束。

`main()` 的第一步先拦截 `records` 分支，按子命令名选择实现模块；若缺 `miles` 包则给出「需在锁定运行时中运行」的退出提示：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L26-L44](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L26-L44)。这段代码同时示范了「延迟导入」模式——`importlib.import_module` 只在确定目标后才执行。

主解析器只有三个位置参数：命令、配置路径与可重复的 `--set` 覆盖：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L45-L57](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L45-L57)。L46 的 `choices=("plan", "validate", "train", "run", "status")` 就是「五个子命令」的出处。

`execute()` 读取 TOML 文档后，用 `schema_version in payload or "model" in payload` 判定结构化与否，再分别构造 `RunSpec`（经 `specs.from_dict`）或 `RunConfig`：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L66-L73](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L66-L73)。这是「TOML → RunSpec → RunConfig」编译链的入口（编译链细节在 u8-l2 精读）。

`plan` 分支调用 `config.plan()` 并打印 JSON 与 advisories，不做任何 GPU 操作：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L74-L78](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L74-L78)。

`run`/`status` 要求结构化文件并延迟导入 `execution.launch`：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L79-L87](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L79-L87)。L81 的报错信息直接写明「raw configs support plan/validate/train」。

`validate` 与 `train` 的分发：结构化校验会连物理分配一起 `plan()`，而训练交给 `workflow.execute`（细节在 u8-l3）：[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L96-L109](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L96-L109)。OPD（蒸馏）规格有独立分支（L88-L95），本讲不展开。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：在无 GPU、无 MILES 运行时的机器上，用 `plan` 验证一份维护示例配置，体会「规划不需要 GPU 栈」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 在仓库根目录执行（open-instruct 用 uv 管理依赖，见 u1-l2）：

   ```bash
   uv run python -m open_instruct.miles plan configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml
   ```

2. 观察输出的 JSON 计划（包含解析后的拓扑、批次几何与编译选项）以及 advisories 提示。
3. 再试一次带覆盖的规划，观察字段被就地替换：

   ```bash
   uv run python -m open_instruct.miles plan configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml \
     --set training.num_rollouts=2
   ```

4. 故意打错命令名验证 argparse 的 choices 约束：

   ```bash
   uv run python -m open_instruct.miles plans configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml
   ```

**需要观察的现象**：步骤 1/2 输出计划 JSON 与提示；步骤 3 中 `training.num_rollouts` 从模板里的 4 变为 2；步骤 4 报 `invalid choice` 错误并列出五个合法命令。

**预期结果**：`plan` 只做 CPU 侧的配置解析与物理分配规划，不触发 GPU 运行时导入；本讲撰写时未在本地实际执行该命令，输出样例**待本地验证**（文档承诺见 [docs/miles/index.md:L21-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L21-L23)）。注意：模板中的 `/weka/.../YOUR_USERNAME/...` 是占位路径，个别校验可能对其报提示，属正常现象；`plan` 不要求挂载这些路径。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `run`/`status` 拒绝低层原始配置（`RunConfig`），只接受 `schema_version=1` 的结构化文件？

**参考答案**：`run` 要把「模型、数据、拓扑、启动、挂载」完整编译成 Beaker 实验，这些信息只有结构化 RunSpec 才齐备；低层 `RunConfig` 只描述训练器参数，缺少提交所需的 launch/output 等段落。源码在 [open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L79-L81](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L79-L81) 显式报错。

**练习 2**：`python -m open_instruct.miles records summarize` 与 `plan` 对运行环境的依赖有何不同？

**参考答案**：`records summarize` 分发到 MILES 包内的 `miles.utils.record_summary`，需要安装 MILES 私有运行时（缺失时报「requires the MILES package」）；`plan` 只依赖 open-instruct 的 CPU 配置代码，无需 GPU 栈。见 [open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L27-L44](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L27-L44)。

**练习 3**：`--set name=my-run` 这样的覆盖发生在哪个阶段？与直接改 TOML 有何区别？

**参考答案**：覆盖作为 `overrides` 参数传给 `specs.from_dict` / `RunConfig.from_dict`（[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L69-L73](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L69-L73)），在解析时叠加到 TOML 文档之上。区别：TOML 文件保持原样（可继续作为版本化的基准），覆盖只影响这一次调用，适合临时调参、sweep 与调试。

### 4.2 架构分层：三层所有权与适配器包布局

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

MILES 不是「又一个训练脚本」，而是把一次 RL 运行拆给三个所有者：

- **open-instruct 包装层**：研究者面对的一切——配置校验、数据准备、验证器/奖励、Beaker 提交与回执、运行产物。
- **MILES 运行时**（私有、按锁定制）：rollout actor、SGLang 推理引擎、采样/优势/损失机制、共享传输。
- **Core 适配器**（位于 MILES 内）：模型构建、打分与训练前向、梯度同步、优化器与 checkpoint、权重导出；训练走 OLMo-core，服务走 SGLang。

为什么要有这条边界？因为 open-instruct 是公开研究仓库，而 MILES 运行时（含其 pinned fork）是独立发布的私有组件。open-instruct 负责「研究者想要什么」，MILES 负责「RL 机制怎么做」，Core 适配器负责「在 OLMo-core 上真正训练」。理解这条边界后，你在 open-instruct 仓库里看到的每个 `open_instruct/miles/` 子包都能归位到某一层。

同时要记住：**MILES 不取代既有 GRPO 训练器**。`grpo.py`（Core/vLLM）与 `grpo_fast.py`（DeepSpeed/vLLM，u6-l4 讲过其 Ray 拓扑）仍是稠密模型训练与历史复现的现行选择；MILES 面向受支持的 Olmo MoE 模型（也提供稠密 Olmo 3 适配器，但验证较少）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一次 MILES 运行的纵向视角：

```text
研究者编写 run.toml（schema_version=1）
        │  python -m open_instruct.miles plan / validate      ← open-instruct：CPU 校验与规划
        ▼
RunSpec ──编译──▶ RunConfig（含 CoreConfig 与原生 MILES 选项）
        │  python -m open_instruct.miles run                  ← open-instruct：编译 Beaker 实验并提交
        ▼
Beaker 上的应用镜像（按 runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json 构建）
        │
        ▼
MILES 运行时启动：Ray 集群、裁判加载、工作流准备并发启动
        │
        ▼
Core 适配器（OLMoCoreTrainRayActor）：SGLang 服务策略 → rollout → 打分 →
OLMo-core 训练前向/反向 → 权重发布（refresh/barrier/engine_drain）→ checkpoint/导出
```

分层所有权表（五层，前三层是所有权划分，后两层是上游基座）：

| 层 | 拥有 |
|---|---|
| Open Instruct 包装层 | 配置校验、准备、验证器、提交/回执、运行产物 |
| MILES 运行时 | rollout actor、SGLang 引擎、采样/优势/损失机制、共享传输助手 |
| Core 适配器（在 MILES 中） | 模型构建、文档/回放对齐、打分与训练前向、梯度同步、优化器/checkpoint、张量导出 |
| OLMo-core | 模型与分布式训练原语、注意力/专家执行 |
| olmo-sglang | 服务架构注册与模型专属执行 |

运行时依赖的「事实源」是 `runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json`——锁定依赖 commit 与不可变二进制基座，构建时不打补丁、不跟随分支尖端；open-instruct 自身的普通环境保持独立版本：[docs/miles/architecture.md:L25-L30](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L25-L30)。这就是「MILES 训练镜像 ≠ open-instruct 开发环境」的原因（对启动与镜像的影响见 u8-l8）。本轮 #2293 给了一个活例子：锁中 MILES 运行时的 revision 从 22d2fb4c 前进到 9eff46a4（[runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json:L13-L16](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json#L13-L16)）——open-instruct 侧代码零改动，但镜像必须按新锁重建才能带上 writer-only HF 导出存储与启动权重检查等修复。

open-instruct 侧的代码按职责分包，`configuration`/`execution` 等八个包与 MILES 侧 `backends/core_utils` 的分工表在：[docs/miles/architecture.md:L271-L298](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L271-L298)。L288-L291 特别澄清了三个容易混淆的数据模块：MILES `backends/core_utils/data.py` 适配样本给训练器；`rollout/data_source.py` 拥有运行时数据源行为；`datasets/run_data.py` 准备研究者输入。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：MILES 与 `grpo_fast.py` 都用 Ray + 多进程做 RL，本质区别是什么？

**参考答案**：`grpo_fast.py` 是 open-instruct 仓库内的一个完整训练脚本（DeepSpeed 训练器 + vLLM 引擎，代码全部在本仓库，u6-l4）；MILES 把「rollout 编排与共享 RL 机制」交给私有 MILES 运行时（按 `runtime.lock.json` 锁定），open-instruct 只保留配置/数据/奖励集成与提交，训练走 OLMo-core、服务走 SGLang。另见 [docs/miles/index.md:L8-L13](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L8-L13)：引入 MILES 不弃用既有 GRPO 训练器。

**练习 2**：如果要在 MILES 训练中新增一种自定义验证器，改动应落在哪一层？为什么？

**参考答案**：落在 open-instruct 包装层的 `open_instruct/miles/rewards/`（验证器、奖励路由与托管裁判），以可信注册表条目（factory + 配置）暴露给 MILES。因为后端训练器与托管 rollout 模块不导入 open-instruct（[docs/miles/architecture.md:L304-L313](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L304-L313)），MILES 侧只通过约定路径消费应用侧回调与注册表。（验证器细节见 u8-l6。）

**练习 3**：为什么 open-instruct 的普通 `uv.lock` 环境跑不了 MILES 训练，而 `plan` 却能跑？本轮运行时锁前进后，旧镜像还能继续用吗？

**参考答案**：训练需要 MILES 私有运行时、SGLang 与锁定版本的 OLMo-core，这些由 `runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json` 与专用应用镜像提供（[docs/miles/architecture.md:L25-L30](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L25-L30)、[docs/miles/architecture.md:L179-L193](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/architecture.md#L179-L193)）；`plan` 只走 CPU 配置代码，CLI 把运行时 import 延迟到需要它的命令（[open_instruct/miles/__main__.py:L4-L5](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/open_instruct/miles/__main__.py#L4-L5)）。旧镜像不可靠：锁的 revision 已从 22d2fb4c 升到 9eff46a4（[runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json:L13-L16](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/runtime/miles/runtime.lock.json#L13-L16)），examples README 明确提醒 launcher 只核对镜像 ID、不核对镜像内源码是否匹配当前锁，应核对镜像构建记录或直接重建（[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L83-L91](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L83-L91)）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：想在本地修改 `docs/miles/configuration.md` 中的一个字段默认值，直接编辑该文件对吗？

**参考答案**：不对。`configuration.md` 等生成式参考页由 MkDocs 从配置源在内存中生成、不入库；应编辑源定义与审校描述，再用 `python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs` 重新生成、`--check` 校验。见 [docs/miles/index.md:L55-L63](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/index.md#L55-L63)。

**练习 2**：`docs/miles/olmo35-small.md` 为什么不加入 `docs/miles/index.md` 的文档地图表？它经由什么路径被读者找到？

**参考答案**：首页表格是按「什么时候用」组织的精选主表，面向通用工作流；olmo35-small.md 是特定模型（OLMo 3.5 Small）+ 特定硬件（B300）的实测记录，读者群更窄。它经由 mkdocs 站点导航的 "Models and training" 组接入（[mkdocs.yml:L110](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/mkdocs.yml#L110)），并被 `configs/miles/examples/README.md` 与 small 配方文件的注释引用。检索文档时不能只看首页表。

**练习 3**：`core.reward_final_answer_only` 的库默认值与维护示例值分别是什么？为什么示例要显式写出？

**参考答案**：库默认 `false`（保留历史判分行为），维护示例显式设 `true`（思考型策略只判交付响应）。示例是配置基线——除非 run 明确声明，应以示例为准，显式写出避免「沉默改变目标」。见 [docs/miles/grading.md:L7-L12](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/grading.md#L7-L12) 与 [configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml:L71-L77](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml#L71-L77)。

### 4.4 示例家族划分：tiny 与 small

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

维护示例（maintained examples）是 MILES 的「配置基线」：除非 run 明确声明，应以示例为准。示例按**模型家族**重组为 `tiny/` 与 `small/` 两个目录，近两轮这两个家族的分工与基线发生了两次实质变化：

- **tiny 家族**：微型模型的力学/学习示例——`dev.toml`（单 GPU 共置力学检查）、`node.toml`（单节点学习）、`three-node.toml`（三节点学习 + 后台评估）。上一轮统一了 Tiny 学习基线：256 prompts × 8 responses、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6 无 warmup、token-mean loss；本轮 #2289 又统一了恢复保存基线：每 10 更新保存、保留最近 2 份、node 按 50 更新留里程碑（与既有的 50 更新开发面板对齐）、three-node 按 100 更新留里程碑，外加最终存档。
- **small 家族**：上一轮删除 `small/dev.toml` 占位，换成**实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B，KDA + 256 专家 MoE）B300 三档配方**：`two-node-mech.toml`（两节点力学检查，4 次更新，仍不保存 checkpoint）、`four-node.toml` 与 `eight-node.toml`（30 更新起步预算布局，本轮从「禁用保存、不自动恢复」翻转为启用与 Tiny 相同的有界恢复保存 + `auto_resume = true`）。

同时，**全部维护示例的损失基线从 per-response 翻转为 token-mean**：`miles.calculate_per_token_loss = true`。注意省略该设置时库默认仍是 `false`（response-mean），这是为兼容既有 run 而刻意保留的——所以每个示例都把它显式写出。

为什么按模型家族分目录？因为 serving 几何、显存账目、准入参数都是模型专属的：Small 文档明确告诫「不要把 Tiny 的 12.5B 推理 preset、评估 profile 或缓存几何复制进 Small」。

本轮还有一个容易被忽略的运维细节：#2293 把三份 Small 配方的 `heartbeat_timeout` 从 120 秒升到 480 秒——启用恢复保存与自动重启后，保存/恢复期间驱动可能长时间不发包，过紧的心跳会被误判为僵死（恢复语义详见 u8-l3）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

当前六份维护示例的分工（与 README 表格一致，最后一列是本轮 #2289 固化的恢复保存基线）：

| 配置 | 家族 | 用途 | 恢复保存基线 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiny/dev.toml` | tiny | 单 GPU、训练/推理共置；GSM8K 短力学检查 | 独立短跑设置（保留原样） |
| `tiny/node.toml` | tiny | 单个 8 GPU 节点：2 训练 GPU（EP2）+ 6 推理引擎；无裁判 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 50 更新里程碑 + 最终存档 |
| `tiny/three-node.toml` | tiny | 三节点学习：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、15 推理引擎 + 1 裁判；24 GPU，另加后台评估 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 100 更新里程碑 + 最终存档 |
| `small/two-node-mech.toml` | small | OLMo 3.5 Small 力学检查：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、7 引擎、1 裁判；4 次更新 | 不保存、不自动恢复（保持不变） |
| `small/four-node.toml` | small | Small 起步预算布局：8 训练 GPU（EP8）、23 引擎（R=96）、1 裁判；审计中位数约 302 s/更新 | 每 10 更新；保留 2 份 + 50 里程碑 + 最终存档；`auto_resume = true` |
| `small/eight-node.toml` | small | Small 起步预算布局：16 训练 GPU（2 × EP8）、47 引擎（R=96）、1 裁判；晚期窗口中位数约 185 s/更新 | 同 four-node |

近两轮基线变化的要点：

```text
损失加权（上一轮 #2271）：
            per-response（response-mean）      →  token-mean（calculate_per_token_loss = true）
           （省略该设置时库默认仍为 response-mean，兼容既有 run）

Tiny 学习（上一轮 #2271）：
            128 prompts × 8，batch 1024        →  256 prompts × 8，batch 2048
学习率：    （模板未显式设置）                  →  learning_rate = 6e-6，恒定、无 warmup

small 家族（上一轮 #2280）：
            small/dev.toml（tiny dev 的占位副本）→  三份实测 B300 配方 + docs/miles/olmo35-small.md
                                                +  configs/miles/moe_configs/（fused-MoE tile 调优）

学习示例恢复保存（本轮 #2289）：
            Tiny 学习模板 save_interval = 25    →  save_interval = 10 + checkpoint_keep_last = 2
                                                    + checkpoint_keep_every（node/Small=50，three-node=100）
                                                    + save_final_checkpoint = true
            Small four/eight-node：              →  启用上述保存基线 + auto_resume = true
            save_checkpoints = false、auto_resume = false

心跳超时（本轮 #2293）：
            Small 三份配方 heartbeat_timeout     →  480 秒（原 120 秒）
```

两个容易踩的陷阱：

1. **历史上的 Small 吞吐计时用的是旧设置**（batch 1024、LR 1e-6、response-mean，且未启用 code grading），且全部是**关闭保存**的运行——不含保存 I/O 开销。新基线（含每 10 更新的保存）不可直接沿用旧数字。
2. **里程碑间隔是「为扩展预留」的**：30 更新起步预算下，50/100 里程碑不会在本次运行内触发；它们只在把 `num_rollouts` 扩大后才生效。README 因此提醒：无 checkpoint 的计时实验要显式关掉保存与自动恢复并删掉 `save_interval`，且不要把该覆盖带进学习 run。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

示例 README 开头声明家族划分：`small` 家族持有实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 布局并链接配方文档：[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L1-L6](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L1-L6)。

**实践目标**：通过只读命令核对两个家族的分工、token-mean 基线与本轮恢复保存基线，理解「示例即基线」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 列出两个家族的文件并确认占位已删除：

   ```bash
   ls configs/miles/examples/tiny configs/miles/examples/small
   git log --oneline --diff-filter=D -- configs/miles/examples/small/dev.toml
   ```

2. 全局核对 token-mean 基线与恢复保存基线：

   ```bash
   grep -n "calculate_per_token_loss" configs/miles/examples/*/*.toml
   grep -n "save_interval\|save_checkpoints\|checkpoint_keep_every\|save_final_checkpoint\|auto_resume" \
     configs/miles/examples/*/*.toml

   ```

3. 对照 Tiny 学习基线与 Small 的共享值（以 node 与 two-node-mech 为例）：

   grep -n "learning_rate\|rollout_batch_size\|global_batch_size" \

5. 用本轮 diff 核对翻转轨迹：

   git diff 2f7889da9248629f9415a80a45ba882544b82f1f..2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033 \

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`tiny/` 与 `small/` 两个家族各自的分工是什么？为什么 Small 没有单 GPU 训练配方？

**参考答案**：`tiny/` 是 Tiny 微型模型的力学检查（dev）与学习示例（node/three-node）；`small/` 是实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B）B300 布局：two-node-mech 做力学检查，four/eight-node 做起步预算布局。Small 没有单 GPU 训练配方、两节点（8 训练 GPU + 7 引擎 + 1 裁判）是其最小已测配置——见 [configs/miles/examples/README.md:L17-L19](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L17-L19)。

**练习 2**：示例都写了 `calculate_per_token_loss = true`，为什么库默认仍是 `false`？这两者矛盾吗？

**参考答案**：不矛盾。库默认保留 response-mean 是为了兼容既有 run——省略该设置的老配置行为不变；维护示例显式设 `true` 是把新基线写清楚，避免「沉默改变目标」。development-defaults 同样写明「Omitted library settings retain response-mean weighting for compatibility」（Loss weighting 条目，其上一条即 Tiny learning batch and LR）：[docs/miles/development-defaults.md:L18-L23](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/development-defaults.md#L18-L23)。

**练习 3**：Small four/eight-node 的 30 更新预算下，保存点落在哪里？50 更新里程碑有什么用？为什么 README 要求「首个完整恢复保存应落在受保护最短运行时之内」？

**参考答案**：`save_interval = 10` 且启用最终存档，30 更新预算在 10/20/30 三处保存；`checkpoint_keep_every = 50` 在本次起步预算内不会触发，它是为把 `num_rollouts` 扩大后的长运行预留的永久里程碑（见 [docs/miles/olmo35-small.md:L235-L238](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/docs/miles/olmo35-small.md#L235-L238)）。受保护最短运行时是调度器保证的连续执行窗口：若首个完整保存来不及在窗口内落盘，一次抢占就会让整个 run 从零开始，恢复保存形同虚设；因此间隔要从实测墙钟时间选（目标约 1-2 小时一次，Tiny seed17 约 5-7 分钟/更新即约 50-70 分钟/10 更新），放不进就缩短间隔或修改预算（[configs/miles/examples/README.md:L341-L356](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/2063f854b37cd380e55f5509df7ea50b6d8a1033/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L341-L356)）。另注意历史 Small 计时是关闭保存的运行，不含保存 I/O 开销，不能直接当作当前配方的 checkpoint 预测。
